description:
Scholarship Overview

The Sir James McNeill Postgraduate Research Scholarship (SJMN) is a full-funded graduate research scholarship at Monash University, awarded every two years. The 2026 application deadline is 31 October 2026. The scholarship is available for Research Doctorate (PhD) and Research Masters programs at Monash University's Melbourne campuses. Eligible faculties are Arts (School of Music only), Engineering, Medicine/Nursing/Health Sciences, and Science.

Benefits & Coverage

  • Living allowance (stipend) of approximately AUD $4,467 per month, totalling AUD $53,608 per year (2026 rate).
  • Full tuition fee coverage (Research Training Program fee offset).
  • Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for international students.
  • Relocation allowance (if eligible) for interstate or overseas relocation.
  • Research allowance for thesis and research costs.
  • Professional development opportunities.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Citizenship: Australian citizen, New Zealand citizen, Australian permanent resident, Australian humanitarian visa holder, or international student (no nationality restriction).
  • Research must be environmentally responsible and socially beneficial.
  • Must meet Monash's competitive scholarship selection process requirements.
  • Must meet English language proficiency requirements (IELTS/TOEFL/PTE).
  • Must be enrolled full-time in a Research Master's or PhD program.

Application Process

  1. Choose your research area and identify a potential supervisor using Monash's "Find a Supervisor" tool.
  2. Create an account on the myApp Portal (Monash's official graduate research application portal).
  3. Submit the Graduate Research Admission + Scholarship application with: research proposal, academic transcripts (certified copies), degree certificates, English proficiency proof, academic CV (max 2 pages), and contact details of 2 referees.
  4. Submit by 31 October 2026 (Round 4 closing).
  5. Eligible applicants are automatically considered – no separate scholarship form is required.

Key Dates & Timeline

Official Application Link

  • Sir James McNeill Scholarship Official Page: https://www.monash.edu/study/fees-scholarships/scholarships/find-a-scholarship/sir-james-mcneill-postgraduate-research-scholarship
  • Graduate Research Application Portal (myApp): https://www.monash.edu/graduate-research/study/apply

Contact

  • Email: mgro-apply@monash.edu

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Important Notes

  • Extremely competitive – only 1 scholarship is awarded every 2 years.
  • Research theme should be environmentally responsible and socially beneficial.
  • Faculty restrictions apply: only Arts (Music), Engineering, Medicine/Nursing/Health Sciences, and Science are eligible.
  • No separate scholarship form – automatic consideration with course application.
  • Supervisor contact is required before application for most faculties.

2026 RTP rate: the full-time RTP stipend is A$34,315 per year, tax-free, indexed annually.

About Monash University - Ghedini Lab

The Ghedini Lab at Monash University in Melbourne, Australia, studies community ecology and evolution. Its research uses marine phytoplankton to investigate how species traits, metabolism and interactions shape ecological communities. The group combines laboratory experiments with ecological and physiological approaches, exploring questions about community organisation, environmental change and ecosystem functioning.

Official website: https://www.monash.edu

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 31 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
